diapositivas.codigoAnimacion:
<a-entity id="escena_estudio" position="0 0 0" scale="0.12 0.12 0.12">

    <!-- 1. ILUMINACIÓN CINEMÁTICA Y SOMBRAS 3D -->
    <a-light type="ambient" color="#cbd5e1" intensity="0.8"></a-light>
    <a-light type="point" color="#00f0ff" intensity="2.2" distance="14" position="0 3.5 2.5"></a-light>
    <a-light type="point" color="#f59e0b" intensity="1.5" distance="10" position="-3 -1 2"></a-light>
    <a-light type="point" color="#a855f7" intensity="1.2" distance="10" position="3 -1 2"></a-light>

    <!-- 2. HAZ DE LUZ HOLOGRÁFICO Y PLATAFORMA BASE -->
    <a-entity position="0 -1.9 0">
        <!-- Cilindro de luz holográfica vertical ascendente -->
        <a-cylinder radius="3.2" height="4.8" position="0 2.4 0" open-ended="true"
            material="color: #00f0ff; opacity: 0.12; transparent: true; side: double; roughness: 0.1"
            animation="property: material.opacity; to: 0.22; dir: alternate; dur: 1800; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        </a-cylinder>

        <!-- Anillo exterior cibernético girando en sentido horario -->
        <a-ring radius-inner="3.3" radius-outer="3.55" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #00f0ff; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 0.9; opacity: 0.7; transparent: true; side: double"
            animation="property: rotation; to: -90 360 0; dur: 24000; loop: true; easing: linear">
        </a-ring>

        <!-- Anillo intermedio dorado girando en sentido antihorario -->
        <a-ring radius-inner="2.5" radius-outer="2.7" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #fbbf24; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; opacity: 0.65; transparent: true; side: double"
            animation="property: rotation; to: -90 -360 0; dur: 18000; loop: true; easing: linear">
        </a-ring>

        <!-- Anillo interior con pulsación de energía neón violeta -->
        <a-ring radius-inner="1.6" radius-outer="1.8" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #c084fc; emissive: #9333ea; emissiveIntensity: 0.9; opacity: 0.6; transparent: true; side: double"
            animation="property: scale; to: 1.12 1.12 1.12; dir: alternate; dur: 2000; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        </a-ring>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 3. GRAN LIBRO ABIERTO DE LA SABIDURÍA (En el centro inferior) -->
    <a-entity position="0 -1.4 0.6" rotation="25 0 0"
        animation="property: position; to: 0 -1.25 0.6; dir: alternate; dur: 3000; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <!-- Lomo central dorado -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.08" height="1.6" position="0 0 -0.05" rotation="90 0 0"
            material="color: #d97706; metalness: 0.8; roughness: 0.2">
        </a-cylinder>

        <!-- Página Izquierda Abierta -->
        <a-box width="1.1" height="0.06" depth="1.5" position="-0.54 0.05 0" rotation="0 0 14"
            material="color: #fffbeb; roughness: 0.9">
        </a-box>
        <!-- Cubierta Izquierda (Cuero Oscuro) -->
        <a-box width="1.15" height="0.04" depth="1.55" position="-0.56 0.01 0" rotation="0 0 14"
            material="color: #1e1b4b; roughness: 0.4">
        </a-box>
        <!-- Líneas de texto simulado página izquierda -->
        <a-plane width="0.75" height="1.1" position="-0.52 0.09 0" rotation="-90 14 0"
            material="color: #38bdf8; opacity: 0.4; transparent: true">
        </a-plane>

        <!-- Página Derecha Abierta -->
        <a-box width="1.1" height="0.06" depth="1.5" position="0.54 0.05 0" rotation="0 0 -14"
            material="color: #fffbeb; roughness: 0.9">
        </a-box>
        <!-- Cubierta Derecha (Cuero Oscuro) -->
        <a-box width="1.15" height="0.04" depth="1.55" position="0.56 0.01 0" rotation="0 0 -14"
            material="color: #1e1b4b; roughness: 0.4">
        </a-box>
        <!-- Líneas de texto simulado página derecha -->
        <a-plane width="0.75" height="1.1" position="0.52 0.09 0" rotation="-90 -14 0"
            material="color: #fbbf24; opacity: 0.4; transparent: true">
        </a-plane>

        <!-- Cinta Marcapáginas Dorada descansando en el centro -->
        <a-box width="0.1" height="0.02" depth="1.7" position="0 0.08 0.1"
            material="color: #eab308; emissive: #ca8a04; emissiveIntensity: 0.6">
        </a-box>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 4. LUPA CIENTÍFICA DE INVESTIGACIÓN (Flotando arriba a la izquierda) -->
    <a-entity position="-3 1.8 0.3" rotation="-15 25 -20"
        animation="property: position; to: -3 2.15 0.3; dir: alternate; dur: 2700; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine"
        animation__rot="property: rotation; to: -10 35 -15; dir: alternate; dur: 3800; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <a-torus radius="0.5" radius-tubular="0.035"
            material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.4">
        </a-torus>
        <a-circle radius="0.48"
            material="color: #a5f3fc; opacity: 0.45; transparent: true; roughness: 0.1; metalness: 0.8; side: double">
        </a-circle>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.06" height="0.8" position="0 -0.85 0"
            material="color: #78350f; roughness: 0.5">
        </a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.08" position="0 -1.25 0"
            material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2">
        </a-sphere>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 5. BIRRETE ACADÉMICO DE GRADUACIÓN (Flotando arriba a la derecha) -->
    <a-entity position="3 1.8 0.3" rotation="15 -25 10"
        animation="property: position; to: 3 2.15 0.3; dir: alternate; dur: 3100; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine"
        animation__rot="property: rotation; to: 10 -35 15; dir: alternate; dur: 4200; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <a-box width="1.2" height="0.04" depth="1.2" rotation="0 45 0"
            material="color: #0f172a; roughness: 0.5; metalness: 0.3">
        </a-box>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.38" height="0.35" position="0 -0.2 0"
            material="color: #1e293b; roughness: 0.6">
        </a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.06" position="0 0.04 0"
            material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2">
        </a-sphere>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.02" height="0.5" position="0.4 -0.2 0.3" rotation="10 0 -25"
            material="color: #facc15; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.5"
            animation="property: rotation; to: 15 0 -15; dir: alternate; dur: 1500; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        </a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.06" position="0.55 -0.45 0.35"
            material="color: #fbbf24; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.6">
        </a-sphere>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 6. LIBROS ACADÉMICOS FLOTANTES LATERALES -->
    <!-- Tomo I: Carmesí Imperial (Izquierda) -->
    <a-entity position="-3.5 -0.3 0.2" rotation="12 28 -10"
        animation="property: position; to: -3.5 0.25 0.2; dir: alternate; dur: 3400; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine"
        animation__rot="property: rotation; to: 8 38 -6; dir: alternate; dur: 4600; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <a-box width="1.3" height="1.8" depth="0.05" position="0 0 -0.1" material="color: #7f1d1d; roughness: 0.4; metalness: 0.2"></a-box>
        <a-box width="1.3" height="1.8" depth="0.05" position="0 0 0.1" material="color: #991b1b; roughness: 0.4; metalness: 0.2"></a-box>
        <a-plane width="0.75" height="1.1" position="0 0 0.13" material="color: #d97706; emissive: #b45309; emissiveIntensity: 0.4; roughness: 0.3; metalness: 0.8"></a-plane>
        <a-box width="1.18" height="1.68" depth="0.18" position="0.04 0 0" material="color: #fef3c7; roughness: 0.8"></a-box>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.11" height="1.8" position="-0.62 0 0" theta-length="180" rotation="0 90 0" material="color: #7f1d1d; roughness: 0.4"></a-cylinder>
        <a-box width="0.12" height="0.6" depth="0.02" position="0.1 -0.98 0" rotation="0 0 -15" material="color: #fbbf24; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.6"></a-box>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- Tomo II: Azul Zafiro (Derecha) -->
    <a-entity position="3.5 -0.3 0.2" rotation="-10 -25 10"
        animation="property: position; to: 3.5 0.25 0.2; dir: alternate; dur: 3800; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine"
        animation__rot="property: rotation; to: -6 -35 6; dir: alternate; dur: 5000; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <a-box width="1.3" height="1.8" depth="0.05" position="0 0 -0.1" material="color: #1e3a8a; roughness: 0.4; metalness: 0.2"></a-box>
        <a-box width="1.3" height="1.8" depth="0.05" position="0 0 0.1" material="color: #1d4ed8; roughness: 0.4; metalness: 0.2"></a-box>
        <a-plane width="0.75" height="1.1" position="0 0 0.13" material="color: #38bdf8; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 0.5; roughness: 0.3; metalness: 0.8"></a-plane>
        <a-box width="1.18" height="1.68" depth="0.18" position="-0.04 0 0" material="color: #fef3c7; roughness: 0.8"></a-box>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.11" height="1.8" position="0.62 0 0" theta-length="180" rotation="0 -90 0" material="color: #1e3a8a; roughness: 0.4"></a-cylinder>
        <a-box width="0.12" height="0.6" depth="0.02" position="-0.1 -0.98 0" rotation="0 0 15" material="color: #38bdf8; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 0.6"></a-box>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 7. ÁTOMO CUÁNTICO MULTI-EJE (Cúspide de la Ciencia) -->
    <a-entity position="0 2.5 -0.2"
        animation="property: position; to: 0 2.75 -0.2; dir: alternate; dur: 2600; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <a-sphere radius="0.32" material="color: #00f0ff; emissive: #0ea5e9; emissiveIntensity: 1; roughness: 0.1"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.15" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #ffffff; emissiveIntensity: 1.2"></a-sphere>

        <!-- Órbita 1 -->
        <a-entity rotation="50 30 0"
            animation="property: rotation; to: 50 390 0; dur: 5000; loop: true; easing: linear">
            <a-torus radius="0.9" radius-tubular="0.02" material="color: #00f0ff; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; opacity: 0.75; transparent: true"></a-torus>
            <a-sphere radius="0.09" position="0.9 0 0" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #00f0ff; emissiveIntensity: 1"></a-sphere>
        </a-entity>

        <!-- Órbita 2 -->
        <a-entity rotation="-50 -30 0"
            animation="property: rotation; to: -50 -390 0; dur: 7000; loop: true; easing: linear">
            <a-torus radius="1.0" radius-tubular="0.02" material="color: #facc15; emissive: #ca8a04; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; opacity: 0.75; transparent: true"></a-torus>
            <a-sphere radius="0.09" position="-1.0 0 0" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #facc15; emissiveIntensity: 1"></a-sphere>
        </a-entity>

        <!-- Órbita 3 -->
        <a-entity rotation="0 0 90"
            animation="property: rotation; to: 360 0 90; dur: 9000; loop: true; easing: linear">
            <a-torus radius="1.1" radius-tubular="0.018" material="color: #ec4899; emissive: #db2777; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; opacity: 0.7; transparent: true"></a-torus>
            <a-sphere radius="0.08" position="0 1.1 0" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #ec4899; emissiveIntensity: 1"></a-sphere>
        </a-entity>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 8. CONSTELACIÓN DE CHISPAS Y PARTÍCULAS ASCENDENTES -->
    <a-octahedron radius="0.14" position="-1.8 0.8 0.4"
        material="color: #facc15; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; metalness: 0.7"
        animation="property: rotation; to: 360 360 0; dur: 4500; loop: true; easing: linear"
        animation__float="property: position; to: -1.8 1.2 0.4; dir: alternate; dur: 2200; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
    </a-octahedron>
    <a-octahedron radius="0.14" position="1.8 0.8 0.4"
        material="color: #00f0ff; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; metalness: 0.7"
        animation="property: rotation; to: -360 360 0; dur: 4800; loop: true; easing: linear"
        animation__float="property: position; to: 1.8 1.2 0.4; dir: alternate; dur: 2400; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
    </a-octahedron>
    <a-sphere radius="0.06" position="-0.5 -0.6 0.8" material="color: #fef08a; emissive: #facc15; emissiveIntensity: 1"
        animation="property: position; to: -0.5 0.5 0.8; dur: 2800; loop: true; easing: linear">
    </a-sphere>
    <a-sphere radius="0.06" position="0.5 -0.8 0.8" material="color: #bae6fd; emissive: #38bdf8; emissiveIntensity: 1"
        animation="property: position; to: 0.5 0.3 0.8; dur: 3200; loop: true; easing: linear; delay: 400">
    </a-sphere>

    <!-- 9. TIPOGRAFÍA HOLOGRÁFICA CINEMÁTICA CON CAMBIO DE COLOR DINÁMICO -->
    <a-entity position="0 0.1 0.4"
        animation="property: position; to: 0 0.28 0.4; dir: alternate; dur: 2500; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">

        <!-- Insignia Superior Flotante -->
        <a-plane width="2.6" height="0.42" position="0 1.2 0"
            material="color: #0f172a; opacity: 0.8; transparent: true; roughness: 0.4">
            <a-text value="🎓 UNIDAD I • BIENVENIDOS" align="center" color="#38bdf8" width="3.5" position="0 0 0.02"></a-text>
        </a-plane>

        <!-- Capa 1: Sombra Profunda de Contraste para lectura perfecta -->
        <a-text 
            value="Bienvenidos a la clase de\nFundamentos de Metodologia\nde Investigacion" 
            color="#021526" 
            align="center" 
            width="5.35"
            line-height="62"
            position="0.04 -0.04 -0.08">
        </a-text>

        <!-- Capa 2: Halo Neón Trasero (Cambia dinámicamente de Cian Eléctrico a Magenta Neón) -->
        <a-text 
            value="Bienvenidos a la clase de\nFundamentos de Metodologia\nde Investigacion" 
            color="#00f0ff" 
            align="center" 
            width="5.25"
            line-height="62"
            position="0.02 0.02 -0.04"
            animation="property: color; type: color; from: #00f0ff; to: #ec4899; dir: alternate; dur: 2600; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        </a-text>

        <!-- Capa 3: Texto Frontal Cristalino (Cambia dinámicamente de Blanco Puro a Oro Neón Brillante) -->
        <a-text 
            value="Bienvenidos a la clase de\nFundamentos de Metodologia\nde Investigacion" 
            color="#ffffff" 
            align="center" 
            width="5.1"
            line-height="62"
            position="0 0 0"
            animation="property: color; type: color; from: #ffffff; to: #facc15; dir: alternate; dur: 2000; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        </a-text>

        <!-- Subtítulo de las 4 Fases Metodológicas (Cambia de Dorado a Esmeralda Neón) -->
        <a-text 
            value="✦ Observacion  •  Hipotesis  •  Experimentacion  •  Tesis ✦" 
            color="#fbbf24" 
            align="center" 
            width="3.8"
            position="0 -0.85 0"
            animation="property: color; type: color; from: #fbbf24; to: #34d399; dir: alternate; dur: 3200; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        </a-text>
    </a-entity>

</a-entity>
